snippet.title: Mata Hari (2008) | Point & Click Adventure | 4K60 | Longplay Full Game Walkthrough No Commentary
snippet.description:
Longplay of Mata Hari, a 3D point & click adventure game, developed by Cranberry Production, and published by Viva Media. It was released in late November 2008 for the PC only. There are reasons to believe it is running on the same game engine as Black Mirror II/III. Here it is running at a full 3840x2160/4K60 (though the aspect ratio is still 16:10, with bars left and right, same as Black Mirror II), highest possible details. Recorded at 4K60 H.265 HEVC via OBS. This here is the Steam version of the game.


My own refflink for NordVPN, as I get a mighty 40% provision for every purchase made through it!: https://adtr.co/6hu6wy

============
It is a classic style point & click adventure game set just before the beginning of World War I and during the first weeks from the assassination of Franz Ferdinand, taking plance in major western european cities, with everything on par with the rest of the genre when it comes to gameplay, including visuals, but TWO big twists: an inter-city train map puzzle, whenever you need to travel to another location. You have to reach your destination, and avoid the enemy "patrols", who can move in the same directions as you, one step at a time, which makes almost every travel really tiresome and full of RNG. And that is actually the worst aspect of the whole game for me, which is why I skipped it whenever I got the option to do so. The second one is... dancing on stage, for points, money or whatever. It was pretty difficult actually. Apparently there is some way to just grind the points in this game, but I am not sure what it changes - I still got the Good ending, and it's the points/money/experience that determines the ending, I think.

==========================
Steam's summary on the game: 
TRUST NO ONE BUT YOURSELF as you adventure into the dark world of espionage amidst the volatile atmosphere of impending war.
As a double agent, you must find clever ways to pit enemy factions against each other while eluding pursuers in each of your increasingly dangerous missions. As a femme fatale, your notorious charm can entice any man. Yet, will the one man who holds the key to your heart ever be yours?
Based on the true events leading to World War I
Break code, tap phones, use your ingenuity and the era's latest gadgets!
Risk it all as you take on dangerous missions
8 challenging mini-games in 4 thrilling chapters
A variety of endings based on the choices you make in the game
=============================





Timestamps:
0:00:00 - Chapter 1: Dance Manager
0:40:41 - Chapter 2: Secret Papers
2:10:00 - Chapter 3: Airline Plans
3:44:30 - Chapter 4: Destroy Poison Gas Factory
4:39:45 - Ending (Non-Canonical, but Good)
